title: Got any Grapes?
description: A resturant managment game that was inspired by the duck song
how_to_play:
Objective is the serve the ducks before time runs out, you have 3 lives.
drag objects around by clicking on them, there is a trash on the bottom right to get rid of and object. To serve duck simply drag an object onto a request bubble and click on it.
How to make Lemonade:
First pick up lemon and then click on the jug, dispose of lemon, put glass on to the placement area and use the jug to fill the glass with lemonade.
how_it_was_made:
This project was made for my final project in my highschool CS course.
I programmed this using unity, and for the sprites I would use screen shots from the Duck Song MV or quickly scribble them
I have more ideas for this game such as a game progression where you unlock new items to sell but idk if I will get there ¯|(ツ)/¯
